method: Affine conversion of PDF vector objects using the grid lines.
limitations: Values recovered from the OU plot, not individual-level data or an original table.
Visual correspondence with Guzzetta's Figure 4c; the original manual procedure is unknown.
In the primary source, points are mean diameters of reconstructed clusters of observed cases, and the band is a 95% confidence interval.
Diameter is the maximum distance between any two observed cases in the cluster, not central 1D reach.
Noninteger time positions were retained without rounding or interpolation.
Decimal places reflect vector extraction, not epidemiological precision.
Published boxplots are used only as an audit reference; they are not model inputs.
